Subject: Zenith Health Renewal QBR & roadmap — proposed demo windows and chunking approach

Hi Asha / Mark —

Thanks again for agreeing to the renewal QBR and roadmap walkthrough next month. To make the session productive for your mixed stakeholder group (clinical ops, infra, and procurement), we recommend splitting the demo into two focused 45-minute blocks instead of one long session: 1) clinical workflow walkthrough and 2) infra / integration deep-dive. Splitting helps us keep exec time light while giving engineers a deeper follow-up slot.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue Jul 6 — Block 1: 10:00–10:45, Block 2: 11:15–12:00
- Option B: Thu Jul 8 — Block 1: 09:00–09:45, Block 2: 10:15–11:00

Can you please confirm which option works better for your team and whether we should record Block 2 for your engineering review? I've attached an updated QBR agenda and a draft runbook for the demo (demo-runbook-zenith.xlsx) — Marissa will be the primary host for Block 1 and Jonas will own Block 2.

If procurement needs a mutual action plan or DocuSign link before the demo, loop them in and we can fast-track.

Thanks — Priya
